response.sql: WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel), above AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod, o.overall_avg FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT telescref, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod / (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM above) AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above ORDER BY ratio_to_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose modindex values are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the overall mean (a mean of per-telescope averages cannot include them).
Telescopes are grouped by signals.telescref directly, with no join to the telescopes table.
